official_stats.stat: The RBI Ombudsman received 13.34 lakh complaints against banks, NBFCs and payment companies in FY 2024-25, up 13.55% on the year before.
official_stats.source: RBI Ombudsman Annual Report 2024-25, via ANI/The Tribune, Dec 2025

official_stats.stat: Loans and advances were the largest category (29.25%); mobile and electronic banking complaints fell 12.74% year on year. These cover all regulated entities, not payment gateways specifically.
